settings.label: Enabled
settings.hint: Requires EchoIntercept.esp (generated by XEditAssist\tools\build_projectiles.py) to be present and enabled in the load order. With no content there is nothing to conjure, and the plugin will log a warning and stay idle.

settings.label: Hostile Only
settings.hint: Only intercept missiles whose shooter is hostile to the player.

settings.label: Require Player Piloting
settings.hint: Only run while the player is actually flying a ship.

settings.label: One Pulse Per Missile
settings.hint: One orb per missile, as in the dream: 2 missiles -> 2 orbs. Set to 0 to allow a replacement orb after one expires without connecting.

settings.label: Missile Form Keywords
settings.hint: Comma-separated substrings matched against the missile's base projectile Editor ID. Leave empty to consider every hostile missile.

settings.label: Max Engagement Range
settings.hint: Ignore missiles further away than this (game units).

settings.label: Max Concurrent Intercepts
settings.hint: Cap on simultaneous intercepts, to bound both cost and screen clutter.

settings.label: Orb Spell Editor ID
settings.hint: Both records come from EchoIntercept.esp. Editor ID wins over FormID because load order does not shift it; the FormID fields are a fallback for the case where the runtime has no Editor ID for the form. If you need them, the plugin defines 000800 EXPL, 000801 PROJ, 000802 MGEF, 000803 SPEL, and th...

settings.label: Orb Projectile Editor ID
settings.hint: The projectile that spell fires. EchoIntercept uses this to tell its own orbs apart from hostile missiles, so it is required, not optional.

settings.label: Spawn Source
settings.hint: Ship | Pilot — the reference the orb is cast from.

settings.label: Homing Strength
settings.hint: 0..1. How hard the orb snaps onto its intercept heading each frame.

settings.label: Intercept Speed
settings.hint: Orb speed in units/sec. The dream calls for fast but visible, not hitscan.

settings.label: Intercept Radius
settings.hint: Detonate when the orb closes to within this many units of the missile.

settings.label: Orb Lifetime
settings.hint: Seconds before an orb that never connected gives up and vanishes.

settings.label: Attribution
settings.hint: Player | FiringShip | Unchanged Explosions do not damage their own owner's side. Leaving the warhead owned by the enemy that launched it means the early detonation hurts nobody, so Player is the setting that actually delivers the counter-battery kill.

settings.label: Silent Detonation
settings.hint: 1 removes the missile without an explosion (pure point defence, no reflected damage). 0 lets the warhead go off where it was stopped.

settings.label: Star Power Cost Per Intercept
settings.hint: Percent of the pilot's Starborn power drained per intercept. 0 disables the cost.
